author: Clement de Seguins Pazzis
title: Spaces of matrices with a sole eigenvalue
locations: Definition 1, printed page 2; Theorem 2, printed page 3
definition_quote: We say that V is a 1-spec subspace when # Sp_K(M) <= 1 for every M in V.
theorem_quote_normalized: Let V be a 1-spec subspace of M_n(K). If char(K)=2 and n=2, then dim V<=3. Otherwise dim V<=1+binomial(n,2).
application: For W in sl_3(F_2) avoiding characteristic polynomial t^3+t, S=W+F_2 I has at most one eigenvalue in F_2 for every matrix. Apply Theorem 2 at n=3 to obtain dim S<=4, hence dim W<=3 since trace(I)=1.
exception_checked: The characteristic-two exception is only n=2, so it does not affect n=3. The self-contained two-dimensional auxiliary lemma uses the stronger trivial-spectrum hypothesis.
attribution: Existing matrix-space dimension theorem; no novelty claim for that theorem, the traceless corollary or its elementary proof. The present research uses it in a separately proved Heawood-cover density and star-forming gap consequence.
